duplicate_review.notes: Deterministic atom IDs were generated from publication identity + atom kind + canonical statement; no duplicate canonical assertions were retained.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom model is oriented to primary literature and has no dedicated narrative-review synthesis or clinical-recommendation atom kind.

Trial-level quantitative data in this review are secondary reports. They are retained as atoms anchored to the review and tagged secondary_reported_result; they must not be treated as direct extraction from the cited primary trials.
Some review recommendations are represented with author_conclusion or intervention_description plus review_synthesis tags rather than inventing a new atom kind.
extraction_limitations: The source is a narrative review, not a primary study; no systematic search strategy, study-selection flow, formal risk-of-bias method, or certainty framework is reported in the article.
Bibliographic references were not atomized as evidence.
Only independently reusable treatment assertions and major evidence summaries were atomized; background pathophysiology and descriptive epidemiology were not exhaustively atomized.
No primary-study facts were added beyond what this review itself reports.
